name: The Snyder Law Group, LLC
about: The Snyder Law Group, LLC is a personal injury firm with a single office in Baltimore.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Maryland does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Attorney Grievance Commission of Maryland, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 2614 published discipline decisions of the Attorney Grievance Commission of Maryland, 1976 to 2026. 2 of them share a surname with a disciplined attorney and were read against the text of those decisions, which name somebody else. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. Maryland publishes no business register we can query. SDAT's entity search is a form rather than a dataset, its bulk data is sold rather than published, and the state's open data portal carries a count of businesses instead of the register. This is a limit of the published record and not something the firm can change.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 3 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 516 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2016-11-07, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

json_ld_descriptions:
The Snyder Law Group, LLC provides outstanding legal representation in personal injury, medical malpractice, and wrongful death cases. Our team has extensive expertise in handling complex claims, including birth injuries, cerebral palsy, catastrophic accidents, and hospital negligence. We are dedicated to holding negligent parties accountable and fighting tirelessly to secure maximum compensation for our clients.
With a proven track record of success, we offer personalized attention, compassionate support, and aggressive advocacy to help individuals and families navigate challenging legal situations. Whether you’ve suffered due to medical errors, severe injuries, or accidents, we are here to guide you toward justice and recovery.
